attributes.name: Tome of Origami Animals
attributes.powers:
Bury this card to display 3 random allies that have the Animal or Vermin trait from the box. You may play each of these cards as if it is in your hand; after you do, banish it. At the end of the scenario, banish any that remain.

Banish this card to draw 3 random allies that have the Animal or Vermin trait from the box.
